tools.name: search_landcover
tools.description: Find A7-T polygons by revised7 class and area.
tools.output_schema: standard response with GeoJSON EPSG:4326 results

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Find target-class polygons near a reference class.
tools.output_schema: ranked GeoJSON results with true geometry distance
tools.limitations: Agent must ask for missing max_distance_m; no centroid distance.

tools.name: intersect_features
tools.description: Return intersections between classes or geometries.

tools.name: get_ndvi_stats
tools.description: Get NDVI statistics for a polygon/geometry.
tools.output_schema: count, mean, median, std, min, max, p10, p90

tools.name: get_ndwi_stats
tools.description: Get NDWI statistics for a polygon/geometry.
tools.output_schema: count, mean, median, std, min, max, p10, p90

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Assemble model, spatial and spectral evidence.
tools.limitations: No live LLM orchestration in V1.
